_comment: The ONE place for e2e hosts, slugs and backend URLs, in the same shape as the native SDKs' scripts/e2e-env.json. e2e/targets.py resolves it for e2e/android.sh and e2e/ios.sh; nothing else names a host or slug. 'links': the four link slots (host names the environment field the slug is served on). 'expect': what the click-token flows must show (path regex + voucher in customData). 'link_types': one dedicated link per type and environment; a type with no entry for the run's environment is skipped with a notice, never failed. 'link_type_expect': what those links route to (path, voucher, and customData source next to linkType == the type). 'rewarded_link_types': the types whose link pays per_install: an allow install must earn reward.amountMinor, a deny install nothing; the other types must have reward null. 'reward_links': the event-reward links (model -> environment -> link, plus the link's type); an environment without one skips those rows. 'reward_events': what the reward flows send after the install. 'backend_checks': which verify-endpoint fields that environment's backend has deployed (earning: reward + earning on the click; open_count: openCount for the re-engagement rows; events: the click's events field). A false check is recorded as skipped, never pass or fail. 'override_backend': point the debug app at backend_url (Android: debug.linktrail.base; the iOS wrapper ships the binary SDK, which has no override, so iOS skips the real flows on such an environment).
